title: Microsoft Issues OOB Windows Updates to Distrust eMudhra Certificates
excerpt: Microsoft has released out-of-band Windows updates to remove trust in certificates tied to compromised eMudhra keys.
body_html:
Microsoft has rolled out out-of-band updates for Windows systems to strip trust from specific certificates. The update specifically targets certificates tied to compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys.

According to the company, this action is designed to safeguard systems that do not receive automatic updates for certificate trust, ensuring they remain protected against potential security risks associated with the affected keys.
